_note: WW-26: three independently authored COMPLETE briefs per music style -- not one shared request plus a short appended clause. Each brief carries all ten directions (groove, palette, arrangement, energy, cast/version vocal direction, rap-versus-sung hook, immediate scene words, both shifts, short ending). Exactly ONE variant per style is the explicitly upbeat role, within the same music style (no unapproved genre substitution). The arrangement sentence is the trailing clause: the assembled provider style ends with it before the approved pace clause. A variant whose vocals line re-voices the lead (harmony, backing replies, stacks) is marked "revoices_lead": true -- the assembled style then also carries the style's own dry/upfront presence direction, which the per-variant brief would otherwise drop.
